response.content:
Will Book G, page 112. Schuylkill County, Pennsylvania.

In the name of God, Amen. I, THOMAS FLYNN, of the Borough of Minersville in the County of Schuylkill and State of Pennsylvania, being weak in body but of sound mind, memory and understanding, do make and publish this my last Will and Testament.

Item. I give and bequeath unto my beloved wife MARGARET FLYNN the dwelling house and lot whereon I now reside, for and during the term of her natural life.

Item. I give unto my son JOHN FLYNN the sum of one hundred dollars.

Item. I give unto my daughter MARY ANN DOUGHERTY, wife of Patrick Dougherty, the sum of one hundred dollars.

Item. The residue of my estate I direct to be sold and divided equally among my children aforesaid.

I appoint my wife Margaret Flynn and my friend JAMES CONNELL executors of this my last Will.

In witness whereof I have hereunto set my hand and seal this fourteenth day of March, A.D. 1889.

                                        Thomas [his X mark] Flynn  (seal)

Signed, sealed and published in presence of:
  Bernard McGinley
  Owen Brennan

Proved and letters testamentary granted 2nd April 1889.

Will Book G, page 112. Schuylkill County, Pennsylvania.

In the name of God, Amen. I, THOMAS FLYNN, of the Borough of Minersville in the County of Schuylkill and State of Pennsylvania, being weak in body but of sound mind, memory and understanding, do make and publish this my last Will and Testament.

Item. I give and bequeath unto my beloved wife MARGARET FLYNN the dwelling house and lot whereon I now reside, for and during the term of her natural life.

Item. I give unto my son JOHN FLYNN the sum of one hundred dollars.

Item. I give unto my daughter MARY ANN DOUGHERTY, wife of Patrick Dougherty, the sum of one hundred dollars.

Item. The residue of my estate I direct to be sold and divided equally among my children aforesaid.

I appoint my wife Margaret Flynn and my friend JAMES CONNELL executors of this my last Will.

In witness whereof I have hereunto set my hand and seal this fourteenth day of March, A.D. 1889.

                                        Thomas [his X mark] Flynn  (seal)

Signed, sealed and published in presence of:
  Bernard McGinley
  Owen Brennan

Proved and letters testamentary granted 2nd April 1889.

- Volume browsed: Schuylkill County probate records, 1851–1930, image group 007936749 (15 images), chosen as the only digitized probate volume for the county. It is unindexed and not full-text searchable.
- Image range examined: 007936749_00001 to 007936749_00010 (10 of 15 read).
- Found: Thomas Flynn's will on image 007936749_00008 (staged ref results/.staging/5a682e92-2642-473c-aee2-e6ed53607ba1.json; imageRef not returned by the tool). It is Will Book G, page 112, of Thomas Flynn of the Borough of Minersville, dated 14 March 1889 and proved 2 April 1889. It names wife Margaret Flynn, son John Flynn, daughter Mary Ann Dougherty (wife of Patrick Dougherty), and executors Margaret Flynn and James Connell.

I found Thomas Flynn's will in the digitized probate books for Schuylkill County, Pennsylvania. I went through the first ten of the fifteen scanned pages in that volume, which is handwritten and not indexed. The will is dated March 1889 and names a wife, Margaret, a son John, and a daughter, Mary Ann, who is married to a Patrick Dougherty. It does not name a son Patrick or a son James, which conflicts with the family tree on file, so it may concern a different Thomas Flynn or the tree may be wrong. The last five pages have not been read yet. The next step is to compare this will against the family tree before using it as evidence, and to decide whether those last five pages are worth checking.

response.content:
Will Book G, page 112. Schuylkill County, Pennsylvania.

In the name of God, Amen. I, THOMAS FLYNN, of the Borough of Minersville in the County of Schuylkill and State of Pennsylvania, being weak in body but of sound mind, memory and understanding, do make and publish this my last Will and Testament.

Item. I give and bequeath unto my beloved wife MARGARET FLYNN the dwelling house and lot whereon I now reside, for and during the term of her natural life.

Item. I give unto my son JOHN FLYNN the sum of one hundred dollars.

Item. I give unto my daughter MARY ANN DOUGHERTY, wife of Patrick Dougherty, the sum of one hundred dollars.

Item. The residue of my estate I direct to be sold and divided equally among my children aforesaid.

I appoint my wife Margaret Flynn and my friend JAMES CONNELL executors of this my last Will.

In witness whereof I have hereunto set my hand and seal this fourteenth day of March, A.D. 1889.

                                        Thomas [his X mark] Flynn  (seal)

Signed, sealed and published in presence of:
  Bernard McGinley
  Owen Brennan

Proved and letters testamentary granted 2nd April 1889.
